messages:
Elena V: Heads-up — v5-int4 (canary 4%) shows a reproducible degradation on the short-numeric slice. Leaving notes here.
Chris M: rough numbers?
Elena V: sample=4,500 queries over last 3h. ngram-precision@3 down -2.8% vs v4.8 baseline on short-numeric. BLEU-like proxy metric -1.4%. overall traffic shows ~+1% token-loss. latency p95 neutral.
Devin R: short-numeric is which filter exactly?
Elena V: slice filter = short_responses && contains_numeric && route==assistant. median response length < 24 tokens.
Priya S: did we run statistical test? 4.5k sounds decent but small deltas can be noisy.
Elena V: ran bootstrap with 10k resamples. short-numeric precision CI = [-3.6%, -1.9%] so seems consistent. qa-bot also logged regression id=rg_v5_int4_shortnum.
qa-bot: regression_detected id=rg_v5_int4_shortnum severity=medium alerted=oncall@eng-ml
Chris M: do our canary rules trigger an auto-fallback? what's the configured threshold set right now?
Elena V: excerpt from canary config:
```
canary_auto_fallback:
  metric: ngram_precision_3
  drop_pct: 2.0
  min_sample: 2000
  slice_awareness: false
  cooldown_mins: 60
```
Devin R: drop_pct=2.0 is crossed for the slice, but current config is not slice-aware. That would roll back the whole model if triggered — we should avoid wide rollback for this localized degradation.
Priya S: propose: enable slice-aware fallback so only affected slice gets routed back to baseline. Also add a lease-pin TTL for recent active users while we investigate.
Chris M: agree. Suggested mitigation plan:
- reduce canary traffic to 1% (ops)
- spin up focused A/B for short-numeric for 1h
- run synthetic eval of 30k short numeric prompts (qa)
- implement slice-level fallback + min_sample guard (infra)
- add per-layer quant-scale tuning run (eng-ml)
Devin R: for per-layer tuning, we should try small increases to qscale on low-rank attention layers first. example patch snippet:
```
quant_params:
  per_layer_qscale:
    attn: [1.0, 1.05, 1.05, 1.0]
    ff:   [1.0, 1.02, 1.02, 1.0]
```
This is cheap to try and can sometimes fix numeric fidelity issues.
qa-bot: queued synthetic eval job: job=2026-901-shortnum-synth size=30000 ETA=25m
ops-bot: throttling canary to 1% now.
deploy-bot: snapshot created: canary/6367890123/v5-int4 @ us-west1
Chris M: also add top-10 failing prompts and token-level diffs to the canary report — it's crucial for PM triage.
Priya S: +1. And set slice_auto_fallback: true with min_sample=2500 to avoid noisy auto-fallbacks.
Elena V: action items summarized:
- ops: drop canary to 1% and hold (ops-bot)
- qa: run 30k short-numeric synthetic eval and targeted A/B for 60m
- eng-ml: execute per-layer qscale sweep (start conservative)
- infra: enable slice-aware fallback with min_sample=2500 and lease-pin TTL=60m for recent users
- monitoring: add failing-prompts diff to canary report
ops-bot: canary throttled to 1% and lease-pin policy queued for rollout.
qa-bot: synthetic eval started: job=2026-901-shortnum-synth, will post results here.
Elena V: Will post targeted A/B outcome and synth results. If slice-level drop remains >2.0% after tuning, fallback that slice to baseline v4.8. Thanks all :thumbsup: dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/canaries/6367890123
